ledger: Round casino-style table | red surface with green-and-white circular track in foreground | viewed from the opposite side as camera orbits counter-clockwise | remains consistent in shape and surface pattern

Four reddish-brown metal cups | arranged in a cluster/row on the table at 00:00 | reduced to three cups in a tight cluster by 00:08-00:09 | coins render over opaque cup walls at 00:04-00:06, and one cup disappears during camera orbit at 00:08
Gold coins | placed onto table and into cups at 00:00-00:03 | held above and beside cups at 00:08-00:09 | violate depth ordering at 00:04-00:06 by rendering in front of opaque cup walls

Background room architecture (windows, framed boards, seating) | two multi-pane windows and seated patrons visible at 00:03 | shifts smoothly from left to right across the frame as camera orbits counter-clockwise through 00:09 | consistent panoramic geometry

findings.description: After the man lowers a gold coin inside the nearest cup at 00:03, the camera drops to a lower angle where the opaque side wall of the cup should occlude the coin. Instead, from 00:04 to 00:06, the coin renders directly over the exterior surface of the nearest cup's wall, and at 00:06 another coin similarly renders over the exterior wall of the rightmost cup.

findings.entity: Row of four cups on the table
findings.description: From 00:00 through 00:07, four cups are present on the table (arranged in a four-cup row across the table at 00:05-00:07). As the camera continues its smooth orbit to the right between 00:07 and 00:08, the layout shifts incompatibly with the viewpoint change and two of the cups merge/vanish, leaving only three cups on the table for the remainder of the shot.
